gloss: one's last moments; dying hour; end of life

definitions.gloss: one's last moments; death; dying hour
definitions.explanation: The moment of a person's death, and the circumstances surrounding it. Used only of living beings and, by extension, of organizations or eras being spoken of as if they died.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な{最期|さいご}だった。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最期|さいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{看取|みと}る→看取る：20215_mitoru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to be at my father's side at the end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最期|さいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Right up to his final moment, he was concerned about his family.

notes:
Homophone of ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧ (the last one, the end) but not interchangeable: {最期|さいご} is only about the end of a life. Writing ✗⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{看取|みと}る→看取る：20215_mitoru⟧ for a deathbed is a common kanji mistake.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最期|さいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{看取|みと}る→看取る：20215_mitoru⟧: to be with someone when they die
- {最期|さいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧: to meet one's end (in a particular way)
- {最期|さいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: last words
- ⟦{悲惨|ひさん}→悲惨：12633_hisan⟧な{最期|さいご}: a tragic end

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧: the last, the end — general-purpose; use for anything other than dying
- ⟦{臨終|りんじゅう}→臨終：24198_rinjuu⟧: one's dying hour — more formal and clinical, used in medical and religious contexts
